summary: This is a routine 8-K filing by the Federal Home Loan Bank of New York (FHLBNY) reporting the publication of its 2025 Report to Members. The filing contains no event or transaction that qualifies as a special situation — no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. It is a standard update to members regarding the bank's 2025 performance. Accordingly, there are no deal terms, advisors, or structural mechanics to analyze. This filing is purely informational and does not present any event-driven or risk-arbitrage angle.
